description: Create a persisted inventory menu with a title and one to six rows.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a new menu ID, title, and row count, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts menu creation when this execution route is reached.

inputs.name: menu_id
inputs.description: Sets the stable ID used to save and open the new menu.

inputs.name: title
inputs.description: Sets the title shown at the top of the menu.

inputs.name: rows
inputs.description: Sets the menu height from one through six rows.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the menu is saved and ready.

description: Replace one menu slot with an item and an optional click flow.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and Slot, configure the item, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: menu_id
inputs.description: Selects the menu whose slot should change.

inputs.name: slot
inputs.description: Selects the zero-based slot to replace.

inputs.name: material
inputs.description: Selects the material displayed in the slot.

inputs.name: lore
inputs.description: Sets the item lore as lines or comma-separated text.

inputs.name: flow_to_execute
inputs.description: Selects the flow to run when the item is clicked.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the item is saved.

description: Place an item in the first empty slot of a menu.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu, configure the item, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: menu_id
inputs.description: Selects the menu that receives the item.

inputs.name: material
inputs.description: Selects the material displayed in the first empty slot.

inputs.name: lore
inputs.description: Sets the item lore as lines or comma-separated text.

inputs.name: flow_to_execute
inputs.description: Selects the flow to run when the item is clicked.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the item is added.

description: Remove every item from a persisted menu.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu, then continue through Flow after its slots are cleared.

inputs.name: menu_id
inputs.description: Selects the menu whose items should be removed.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after all menu items are cleared.

description: Open a persisted menu for a player.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a Player and Menu, then continue through Flow after the menu opens.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player who should see the menu; uses the current Flow player when omitted.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the menu opens.

description: Refresh an open menu for a player from its persisted definition.
examples: Connect Flow, provide a Player and Menu, then continue through Flow after the open view is refreshed.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player whose open menu should refresh; uses the current Flow player when omitted.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the menu is refreshed.

description: Close the currently open menu for a player.
examples: Connect Flow and provide the Player whose active menu should close.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player whose active menu should close; uses the current Flow player when omitted.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the player's active menu closes.

description: Set the sound played when a menu item is clicked.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and Minecraft sound, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: sound
inputs.description: Selects the sound played for item clicks.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the click sound is saved.

description: Change the title shown by a persisted menu.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu, set its title, then continue through Flow.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the title is saved.

description: Assign a Flow to run when a menu slot is clicked.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu, Slot, and Click Flow, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: slot
inputs.description: Selects the slot whose click action should change.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.description: Selects the flow to run on click.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the click action is saved.

description: Replace a menu slot with an item and a click action in one operation.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu, Slot, item values, and Flow, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: material
inputs.description: Selects the material displayed in the slot.

inputs.name: lore
inputs.description: Sets the item lore as lines or comma-separated text.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.description: Selects the flow to run when the item is clicked.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the item and click action are saved.

description: Toggle the enchanted visual effect on an item in a menu slot.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and Slot, choose whether the item glows, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: slot
inputs.description: Selects the slot whose item should change.

inputs.name: enchanted
inputs.description: Controls whether the item displays the enchanted glow.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the item visual is saved.

description: Replace the item flags applied to a menu slot.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and Slot, provide item flags, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: slot
inputs.description: Selects the slot whose item flags should change.

inputs.name: flags_list
inputs.description: Provides item flag names as a list, lines, or comma-separated text.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the item flags are saved.

description: Set the custom model data value on an item in a menu slot.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and Slot, enter non-negative model data, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts changing the custom model data.

inputs.name: slot
inputs.description: Selects the slot whose item should change.

inputs.name: model_data
inputs.description: Sets the non-negative custom model data value.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the custom model data is saved.

description: Use a player name or UUID as the head texture for an item in a menu slot.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and Slot, provide a player name or UUID, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: slot
inputs.description: Selects the slot whose item should become a player head.

inputs.name: player_name_or_uuid
inputs.description: Provides the player name or UUID used for the head texture.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the head texture is saved.

description: Fill an inclusive range of menu slots with the same item visual.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and slot range, configure the item, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: start_slot
inputs.description: Sets the first slot in the inclusive range.

inputs.name: end_slot
inputs.description: Sets the last slot in the inclusive range.

inputs.name: material
inputs.description: Selects the material placed in every slot.

inputs.name: lore
inputs.description: Sets the item lore as lines or comma-separated text.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after every slot in the range is filled.

description: Remove the item from one menu slot.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and Slot, then continue through Flow after that slot is emptied.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the slot is emptied.

description: Read the item currently stored in one menu slot.
examples: Select a Menu and Slot, then connect Item to an item-compatible input.

outputs.name: item
outputs.description: Returns the item in the selected slot, or an empty result when the slot has no item.

description: Read every non-empty item from a menu in slot order.
examples: Select a Menu and connect Items to a list-compatible input.

outputs.name: items_list
outputs.description: Returns the non-empty menu items ordered by their first slot.

description: Copy a persisted menu under a new stable ID.
examples: Connect Flow, select the source Menu, enter a new ID, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: new_menu_id
inputs.description: Sets the stable ID for the copied menu.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the copied menu is saved.

description: Assign a Flow to run when a menu closes.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and Close Flow, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.description: Selects the flow to run when the menu closes.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the close action is saved.

description: Assign a Flow to run when a menu opens.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu and Open Flow, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.description: Selects the flow to run when the menu opens.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the open action is saved.

description: Configure periodic updates and the Flow run for an open menu.
examples: Connect Flow, select a Menu, set the interval and update Flow, then continue through Flow.

inputs.name: flow
inputs.description: Starts changing the periodic update settings.

inputs.name: interval_ticks
inputs.description: Sets the delay between updates in server ticks; zero disables periodic updates.

inputs.name: flow_id
inputs.description: Selects the flow run for each periodic update.

outputs.name: flow
outputs.description: Continues after the update settings are saved.

description: Return the ID of the menu currently open for a player.
examples: Provide a Player and connect Menu ID to a compatible input.

inputs.name: player
inputs.description: Selects the player whose active menu should be read; uses the current Flow player when omitted.

outputs.name: menu_id
outputs.description: Returns the active menu ID, or an empty value when no menu is open.
